entries.desc: On a clean repo, story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK with a succeeding bootstrap advances phase to INIT_CHECK and creates the worktree (unchanged success behavior)
When dev_start bootstrap throws, story_get still shows the prior phase (INIT), not INIT_CHECK; output reports failure not advancement
A victim already at INIT_CHECK with no worktree re-runs story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK: does not throw INIT_CHECK->INIT_CHECK, re-runs dev_start, no double-advance
lattice dev_start {storyId} on a story stuck in INIT_CHECK with no worktree on disk recreates the worktree and prints its path
lattice dev_start is idempotent: running it when the worktree already exists returns the existing path without error
lattice dev_start is refused in REVIEW/TEST/DONE phases and refused for an INIT story that has not passed the scope-anti-expansion freeze gate
New smoke test runs green under lattice validate, asserting bootstrap-failure leaves phase unchanged and the recovery path re-bootstraps a stuck story
The injected bootstrap-failure path does not require a real failing git operation (uses an injectable seam) yet still exercises the cli-engine ordering
Test guards against regression: if phase were advanced before bootstrap, the partial-advance assertion fails loudly
